title: Remove a package with zypper
summary: Uninstall a specific software package from your system.

steps.explain: Remove the specified package. You can use the full command 'remove' or the short form 'rm'.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form 'rm' instead of 'remove'.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE

placeholders.description: The name of the package to reinstall.

warnings: Removing a package may also remove dependencies that other software relies on.
